records.footnote: Data are used for SDG 16.3.2 'Unsentenced detainees as a proportion of overall prison population'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 16.3.2.

row.rowText: Remandees As Proportion Of Overall Prison Population
row.footnote: Refers to the total number of persons held in remand who have not yet been sentenced, as a percentage of the total inmate population in prisons and in the community, as at the end of each reporting year.
